create_PolygonZone: create a PolygonZone from a numpy array of polygon coordinates to define a detection zone
trigger_PolygonZone: trigger a PolygonZone with Detections to determine which detections fall within the zone
create_PolygonZoneAnnotator: create a PolygonZoneAnnotator to annotate a frame with polygon zone outline and detection count
annotate_PolygonZoneAnnotator: annotate an image scene with a PolygonZoneAnnotator drawing the zone polygon and object count
set_PolygonZone_anchors: set custom triggering_anchors on a PolygonZone to use different bounding box positions for zone detection
